title: 雅思听力精听 #2 · 环保课题讨论（Section 3 三人对话）
topic: 教育 · 环保 · 仿真剑桥 Section 3
goal: 仿真剑桥真题（自编）：Section 3 导师+两名学生的项目讨论（三人三音色对话）。流程：① 先浏览 Questions 21–26 → ② 播放音频作答（文稿默认折叠，先听！做完/对答案再展开）→ ③ 21–23 单选；24–26 笔记填空，每空 ≤2 词。交卷自动批改，错题看解析里的定位句。

passages.title: 精听对话 · 环保课题项目讨论（Tutor + Mia + Jack）

segments.label: Tutor · 导师
segments.text: Right, let's go over your project outline. Mia, you first. How did you choose your topic?

segments.label: Mia · 学生
segments.text: I wanted something local, so I looked at recycling habits in our neighbourhood. We put questionnaires in three hundred letterboxes and got about two hundred replies, which is a really good response rate.

segments.label: Tutor · 导师
segments.text: Indeed it is. And Jack, what's your part of the project?

segments.label: Jack · 学生
segments.text: I'm comparing our figures with the national average. The most surprising finding so far is that only about a third of people rinse their plastic containers before putting them out for recycling.

segments.label: Tutor · 导师
segments.text: That is surprisingly low. So what do you think the main recommendation should be?

segments.label: Mia · 学生
segments.text: Better labelling on the bins themselves — most people told us they simply weren't sure what could be recycled and what couldn't.

segments.label: Jack · 学生
segments.text: And I'd add clearer information from the council about collection days, because a lot of the confusion starts there.

segments.label: Tutor · 导师
segments.text: Good, both of those are practical. Now, have you thought about how you'll present your results? You know the assessment rewards visual material.

segments.label: Mia · 学生
segments.text: We were thinking of a poster showing the numbers, with photos we took at the recycling centre.

segments.label: Jack · 学生
segments.text: And a short leaflet the council could actually print and send out.

segments.label: Tutor · 导师
segments.text: That sounds like a solid plan. Make sure you leave time to rehearse your five-minute presentation — I'd like to see a first draft of the poster by Friday, if that's realistic.

segments.label: Mia · 学生
segments.text: Friday's fine. We'll email it to you by the end of the day.

segments.label: Tutor · 导师
segments.text: Excellent. I'll look forward to it.

passages.body:
Tutor · 导师：Right, let's go over your project outline. Mia, you first. How did you choose your topic?
Mia · 学生：I wanted something local, so I looked at recycling habits in our neighbourhood. We put questionnaires in three hundred letterboxes and got about two hundred replies, which is a really good response rate.
Tutor · 导师：Indeed it is. And Jack, what's your part of the project?
Jack · 学生：I'm comparing our figures with the national average. The most surprising finding so far is that only about a third of people rinse their plastic containers before putting them out for recycling.
Tutor · 导师：That is surprisingly low. So what do you think the main recommendation should be?
Mia · 学生：Better labelling on the bins themselves — most people told us they simply weren't sure what could be recycled and what couldn't.
Jack · 学生：And I'd add clearer information from the council about collection days, because a lot of the confusion starts there.
Tutor · 导师：Good, both of those are practical. Now, have you thought about how you'll present your results? You know the assessment rewards visual material.
Mia · 学生：We were thinking of a poster showing the numbers, with photos we took at the recycling centre.
Jack · 学生：And a short leaflet the council could actually print and send out.
Tutor · 导师：That sounds like a solid plan. Make sure you leave time to rehearse your five-minute presentation — I'd like to see a first draft of the poster by Friday, if that's realistic.
Mia · 学生：Friday's fine. We'll email it to you by the end of the day.
Tutor · 导师：Excellent. I'll look forward to it.

questions.prompt: Why did Mia choose her project topic?
options: A. She wanted to investigate a local issue.
B. A tutor suggested it to her.
C. She had read about it in the news.
questions.explanation: 定位句（Mia）：I wanted something local, so I looked at recycling habits in our neighbourhood。她想研究身边/本地的问题 → A。B、C 在对话中完全没出现——听力单选里没提到的选项直接排除，别脑补。

extra.head:
Questions 21–23
Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.prompt: What is Jack responsible for in the project?
options: B. Comparing their data with national figures.
C. Taking photographs at the recycling centre.
questions.explanation: 定位句（Jack）：I'm comparing our figures with the national average → B。C 是干扰：photos we took at the recycling centre 是 Mia 说的（用于 poster）；A：问卷是两人一起发的（We put questionnaires…），不是 Jack 一个人的分工。多人对话题要盯住 each speaker 说了什么。

questions.prompt: What does the tutor remind them about the assessment?
options: A. It rewards the use of visual material.
B. It is based mainly on the leaflet.
C. It includes a written report.
questions.explanation: 定位句（Tutor）：You know the assessment rewards visual material。导师提醒评分看重视觉材料 → A。B：leaflet 只是 Jack 提的交付物，不是评分主体；C 未提及。注意导师问句里的暗示（have you thought about…presentation?）往往是考点信号。

questions.prompt:
Questions 24–26
Complete the notes below.
Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.
questions.passage: Section 3 项目笔记（24–26 空格）：survey — questionnaires in 300 letterboxes, about __24__ replies；main finding — only __25__ of people rinse plastic containers；presentation — first draft of the poster due by __26__。
questions.explanation: ① 24 = two hundred（两个词）：Mia: got about two hundred replies。② 25 = a third：Jack: only about a third of people rinse their plastic containers（数词 a third 只算两个词）。③ 26 = Friday：Tutor: I'd like to see a first draft of the poster by Friday。技巧：笔记题先扫空位旁的名词预判填什么（数字？比例？星期？），听的时候答案几乎照读。

rows: only __25__ of people rinse plastic containers
first draft of the poster due by __26__
